<includeonly></includeonly><noinclude>{{#cargo_declare:_table=Drops
|CharacterKey=String
|ItemKey=String
|DropProbability=Float
|IsGuaranteed=Boolean
}}
Declare-only owner of the <code>Drops</code> junction (one row per character × dropped item, carrying the drop probability and the guaranteed-pool flag). Rows are written by {{tl|Character}}, which <code>#cargo_attach</code>es this table; this template stores nothing itself. <code>CharacterKey</code> (the dropping character) and <code>ItemKey</code> (the dropped item) are both StableKeys; the character column is <code>CharacterKey</code> rather than <code>Character</code> because <code>CHARACTER</code> is a reserved SQL word the Cargo fork rejects.
</noinclude>
